description: Original-game (Game.exe 1.14d under Wine, i4, Soaky Sorceress, offline, honest play) m1-profile soaks, metrics recomputed from the bot's minute lines by d2dsoak extract so both sides use one definition. Card baselinefree (2026-11-01) added the whole a14 run (a14-full; the 64-line a14 row is kept but excluded from the means), the 8 h G2 run (m24) and per-run clvl band tables (bands), plus provenance fields (run_id, bot, backend, date, profile, weak). Rows with exclude_from_mean stay out of the whole-run means; their bands still count in `d2dsoak bands`.

deaths_per_hour.why: baseline is 0 to 0.5 deaths/h; one extra death per 2 h is noise

potions_per_hour.why: info: vendor prices differ on d2d (docs/d2d-fidelity.md 5)

gold_per_hour.why: info: net balance, stash banking and vendor prices differ

clvl_gain.why: info: depends on the start level

clvl_1h.why: info: only comparable with the same start clvl

clvl_2h.why: info: only comparable with the same start clvl
